roster.name: Sanger FASTQ format
roster.description: A file-format standard for storing nucleotide sequences together with per-base Phred quality scores in a single text file. Specifies record syntax (@seqname, sequence line, '+' separator, quality line), allowed characters/regex for fields, requirement that sequence and quality lengths match, and the Phred+33 encoding with conversion formula Q = ord(q) - 33 (Perl examples).

roster.name: Solexa/Illumina FASTQ variant
roster.description: A variant of the FASTQ file-format used by Solexa/Illumina instruments that differs in how quality scores are encoded/scaled. The seed material documents the distinct quality score scaling and provides a decoding formula (Perl expression) to convert Solexa/Illumina characters into Phred-like quality values, distinguishing it from the Sanger FASTQ encoding.
